name: golukituki-workspace
description: A geography location-guessing game, starting with South Korea.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @golukituki/core build && pnpm --filter @golukituki/web build && pnpm --filter @golukituki/worker build
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @golukituki/web build && concurrently --kill-others --names worker,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @golukituki/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @golukituki/web dev"
scripts.validate: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
